text: OVERDOSAGE The oral LD 50 of sulfacetamide in mice is 16.5 g/kg. The LD 50 for topical administration of sulfacetamide has not been determined. Oral over dosage may cause nausea and vomiting. Large oral overdosage may cause hematuria, crystalluria, and renal shutdown due to precipitation of sulfa crystals in the renal tubules and the urinary tract. For treatment, contact local Poison Control Center.
